Mamai.question: The _____ was Mongol general and kingmaker (died 1380/1381).
Mamai.fact: Mamai (Mongolian: Мамай; Tatar: Мамай, romanized: Mamay; 1325?–1380/1381) was a powerful Turco-Mongol military commander who held the rank of beylerbey in the Golden Horde.
